title: Blacked-out bus ride south to S-4
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Blacked-out bus ride south to S-4, about 1988-1989 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: long bumpy ride. Um And that the windows were blacked out on the bus.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989, says he was taken by bus from Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada, south to an even more hidden site called S-4. According to Lazar, it was a long, bumpy ride and the bus windows were blacked out, so workers could not see where they were going.
